title: Peppol Freelancer Invoice Inbox
oneLiner: A lightweight Peppol readiness inbox that helps freelancers understand, validate, and send structured e-invoices without enterprise software.
targetUser: Freelancers, solo consultants, Belgian and French micro-businesses, and accountants onboarding small clients to Peppol/e-invoicing workflows.
keyUX: The freelancer drops in PDFs, CSV invoice rows, or UBL/XML samples; the app explains what is missing, validates client IDs and required fields, previews the human-readable invoice, and creates a send/receive readiness checklist.
signalRefs: S4 - Reddit r/belgium Peppol tools feel clunky for freelancers
S5 - Service Public Entreprendre France e-invoicing rollout
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app prototype for "Peppol Freelancer Invoice Inbox," a lightweight Peppol readiness inbox for freelancers and micro-businesses preparing for structured e-invoicing. Include: mandate timeline header, invoice intake inbox for PDF/CSV/UBL/XML, plain-language Peppol field validator, client tax ID and routing status panel, human-readable invoice preview, batch validation queue, accountant handoff export, and first compliant invoice checklist. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with compact document queues, precise validation badges, accountant-friendly tables, minimal friction, and clear small-business compliance states; it should feel like a practical inbox for freelancers, not enterprise procurement software.
